title: British Far-Right Commentator Milo Yiannopoulos Arrested by ICE
detail: Milo Yiannopoulos, the British far-right commentator and political provocateur, was arrested by U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement on August 28, 2026. Yiannopoulos, a British national who had lived in the United States for years, was taken into custody by ICE in what represents a notable enforcement action against a high-profile media personality. The arrest was reported by Le Monde and signals continued broad enforcement operations by ICE.
